WITH t AS (
SELECT tr.*, CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS p,
CASE WHEN Date IS NOT NULL AND Time REGEXP '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$'
THEN TIMESTAMP(Date,Time) ELSE NULL END AS ts FROM birdbench.transactions_1k tr),
m AS (SELECT CustomerID, Date AS ym, STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(Date,'01'),'%%Y%%m%%d') AS md,
CAST(Consumption AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS v FROM birdbench.yearmonth
WHERE Date REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' AND LEFT(Date,4) BETWEEN '1000' AND '9999')
, edges AS (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID,ProductID FROM t WHERE CustomerID IS NOT NULL AND ProductID IS NOT NULL),
sizes AS (SELECT ProductID,COUNT(*) n FROM edges GROUP BY ProductID),
pairs AS (SELECT a.ProductID pa,b.ProductID pb,COUNT(*) n FROM edges a JOIN edges b ON a.CustomerID=b.CustomerID AND a.ProductID<b.ProductID GROUP BY a.ProductID,b.ProductID)
SELECT pa product_a,pb product_b,x.n shared_customers,a.n+b.n-x.n union_customers,ROUND(CAST(x.n AS DECIMAL(60,18))/(a.n+b.n-x.n),6) jaccard FROM pairs x JOIN sizes a ON pa=a.ProductID JOIN sizes b ON pb=b.ProductID ORDER BY pa,pb

WITH t AS (
SELECT tr.*, CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS p,
CASE WHEN Date IS NOT NULL AND Time REGEXP '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$'
THEN TIMESTAMP(Date,Time) ELSE NULL END AS ts FROM birdbench.transactions_1k tr),
m AS (SELECT CustomerID, Date AS ym, STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(Date,'01'),'%%Y%%m%%d') AS md,
CAST(Consumption AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS v FROM birdbench.yearmonth
WHERE Date REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' AND LEFT(Date,4) BETWEEN '1000' AND '9999')
, edges AS (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID,ProductID FROM t WHERE CustomerID IS NOT NULL AND ProductID IS NOT NULL),
sets AS (SELECT CustomerID,COUNT(*) n,GROUP_CONCAT(ProductID ORDER BY ProductID SEPARATOR ',') signature FROM edges GROUP BY CustomerID),
classes AS (SELECT n,signature,COUNT(*) k FROM sets GROUP BY n,signature)
SELECT n product_count,k customers_per_class,COUNT(*) class_count FROM classes GROUP BY n,k ORDER BY n,k

WITH t AS (
SELECT tr.*, CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS p,
CASE WHEN Date IS NOT NULL AND Time REGEXP '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$'
THEN TIMESTAMP(Date,Time) ELSE NULL END AS ts FROM birdbench.transactions_1k tr),
m AS (SELECT CustomerID, Date AS ym, STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(Date,'01'),'%%Y%%m%%d') AS md,
CAST(Consumption AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS v FROM birdbench.yearmonth
WHERE Date REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' AND LEFT(Date,4) BETWEEN '1000' AND '9999')
, edges AS (SELECT DISTINCT GasStationID,ProductID FROM t WHERE GasStationID IS NOT NULL AND ProductID IS NOT NULL),
sizes AS (SELECT GasStationID,COUNT(*) n FROM edges GROUP BY GasStationID),
intersections AS (SELECT a.GasStationID sa,b.GasStationID sb,COUNT(*) n FROM edges a JOIN edges b ON a.ProductID=b.ProductID AND a.GasStationID<>b.GasStationID GROUP BY a.GasStationID,b.GasStationID)
SELECT a.n smaller_product_count,COUNT(*) station_pair_count FROM intersections x JOIN sizes a ON sa=a.GasStationID JOIN sizes b ON sb=b.GasStationID WHERE x.n=a.n AND a.n<b.n GROUP BY a.n ORDER BY a.n

WITH t AS (
SELECT tr.*, CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS p,
CASE WHEN Date IS NOT NULL AND Time REGEXP '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$'
THEN TIMESTAMP(Date,Time) ELSE NULL END AS ts FROM birdbench.transactions_1k tr),
m AS (SELECT CustomerID, Date AS ym, STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(Date,'01'),'%%Y%%m%%d') AS md,
CAST(Consumption AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS v FROM birdbench.yearmonth
WHERE Date REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' AND LEFT(Date,4) BETWEEN '1000' AND '9999')
, edges AS (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID,ProductID FROM t WHERE CustomerID IS NOT NULL AND ProductID IS NOT NULL),
sizes AS (SELECT ProductID,COUNT(*) n FROM edges GROUP BY ProductID), universe AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) n FROM edges),
pairs AS (SELECT a.ProductID pa,b.ProductID pb,COUNT(*) n FROM edges a JOIN edges b ON a.CustomerID=b.CustomerID AND a.ProductID<b.ProductID GROUP BY a.ProductID,b.ProductID HAVING COUNT(*)>=2)
SELECT pa product_a,pb product_b,x.n shared_customers,ROUND(CAST(x.n AS DECIMAL(60,18))*u.n/(a.n*b.n),6) lift FROM pairs x JOIN sizes a ON pa=a.ProductID JOIN sizes b ON pb=b.ProductID CROSS JOIN universe u ORDER BY pa,pb

CASE WHEN Date IS NOT NULL AND Time REGEXP '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$'

cd AS (SELECT CustomerID,COUNT(*) n FROM edges GROUP BY CustomerID),kd AS (SELECT CardID,COUNT(*) n FROM edges GROUP BY CardID)
SELECT cd.n customer_card_degree,kd.n card_customer_degree,COUNT(*) edge_count FROM edges e JOIN cd ON e.CustomerID=cd.CustomerID JOIN kd ON e.CardID=kd.CardID GROUP BY cd.n,kd.n ORDER BY cd.n,kd.n

WITH t AS (
SELECT tr.*, CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS p,
CASE WHEN Date IS NOT NULL AND Time REGEXP '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$'
THEN TIMESTAMP(Date,Time) ELSE NULL END AS ts FROM birdbench.transactions_1k tr),
m AS (SELECT CustomerID, Date AS ym, STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(Date,'01'),'%%Y%%m%%d') AS md,
CAST(Consumption AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS v FROM birdbench.yearmonth
WHERE Date REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' AND LEFT(Date,4) BETWEEN '1000' AND '9999')
, a AS (SELECT c.Currency,t.TransactionID,t.p,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY c.Currency ORDER BY t.p,t.TransactionID) rn,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY c.Currency) n FROM t JOIN birdbench.customers c ON t.CustomerID=c.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency IS NOT NULL AND t.p IS NOT NULL),
med AS (SELECT Currency,MAX(n) n,AVG(p) med FROM a WHERE rn IN (FLOOR((n+1)/2),FLOOR((n+2)/2)) GROUP BY Currency),
dev AS (SELECT a.Currency,a.TransactionID,ABS(a.p-med.med) d,med.med,med.n FROM a JOIN med ON a.Currency=med.Currency),
ranked AS (SELECT dev.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY Currency ORDER BY d,TransactionID) rn FROM dev)
SELECT Currency currency,MAX(n) observation_count,ROUND(MAX(med),6) median_price,ROUND(AVG(d),6) mad_price FROM ranked WHERE rn IN (FLOOR((n+1)/2),FLOOR((n+2)/2)) GROUP BY Currency ORDER BY Currency

WITH t AS (
SELECT tr.*, CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS p,
CASE WHEN Date IS NOT NULL AND Time REGEXP '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$'
THEN TIMESTAMP(Date,Time) ELSE NULL END AS ts FROM birdbench.transactions_1k tr),
m AS (SELECT CustomerID, Date AS ym, STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(Date,'01'),'%%Y%%m%%d') AS md,
CAST(Consumption AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS v FROM birdbench.yearmonth
WHERE Date REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' AND LEFT(Date,4) BETWEEN '1000' AND '9999')
, u AS (SELECT ProductID,TransactionID,CAST(p AS DECIMAL(60,18))/Amount u FROM t WHERE ProductID IS NOT NULL AND p IS NOT NULL AND Amount>0),
r AS (SELECT u.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY ProductID ORDER BY u,TransactionID) rn,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY ProductID) n FROM u),
q AS (SELECT ProductID,MAX(n) n,MAX(CASE WHEN rn=CEIL(n*0.25) THEN u END) q1,MAX(CASE WHEN rn=CEIL(n*0.75) THEN u END) q3 FROM r WHERE n>=4 GROUP BY ProductID)
SELECT q.ProductID product_id,q.n observation_count,ROUND(q.q1,6) q1,ROUND(q.q3,6) q3,SUM(CASE WHEN u.u<q.q1-1.5*(q.q3-q.q1) OR u.u>q.q3+1.5*(q.q3-q.q1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) outlier_count FROM q JOIN u ON q.ProductID=u.ProductID GROUP BY q.ProductID,q.n,q.q1,q.q3 ORDER BY q.ProductID

SELECT ProductID product_id,MAX(n) original_count,FLOOR(MAX(n)/10) removed_each_tail,COUNT(*) retained_count,ROUND(AVG(CAST(Amount AS DECIMAL(38,12))),6) trimmed_mean FROM r WHERE n>=10 AND rn>FLOOR(n/10) AND rn<=n-FLOOR(n/10) GROUP BY ProductID ORDER BY ProductID

, f AS (SELECT ProductID,Amount,COUNT(*) n FROM t WHERE ProductID IS NOT NULL AND Amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ProductID,Amount),r AS (SELECT f.*,MAX(n) OVER(PARTITION BY ProductID) mx FROM f)
SELECT ProductID product_id,Amount modal_amount,n frequency FROM r WHERE n=mx ORDER BY ProductID,Amount

WITH t AS (
SELECT tr.*, CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS p,
CASE WHEN Date IS NOT NULL AND Time REGEXP '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$'
THEN TIMESTAMP(Date,Time) ELSE NULL END AS ts FROM birdbench.transactions_1k tr),

, a AS (SELECT c.Currency,m.CustomerID,SUM(m.v) v FROM m JOIN birdbench.customers c ON m.CustomerID=c.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency IS NOT NULL AND m.ym>='201301' AND m.ym<'201401' AND m.v IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.Currency,m.CustomerID HAVING SUM(m.v)>0),r AS (SELECT a.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY Currency ORDER BY v,CustomerID) rn FROM a)
SELECT Currency currency,COUNT(*) customer_count,ROUND(2*SUM(CAST(rn AS DECIMAL(60,18))*v)/(COUNT(*)*SUM(v))-CAST(COUNT(*)+1 AS DECIMAL(60,18))/COUNT(*),6) gini FROM r GROUP BY Currency ORDER BY Currency

WITH t AS (

THEN TIMESTAMP(Date,Time) ELSE NULL END AS ts FROM birdbench.transactions_1k tr),

, a AS (SELECT c.Currency,t.ProductID,SUM(t.Amount) v FROM t JOIN birdbench.customers c ON t.CustomerID=c.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency IS NOT NULL AND t.ProductID IS NOT NULL AND t.Amount>0 GROUP BY c.Currency,t.ProductID),b AS (SELECT a.*,SUM(v) OVER(PARTITION BY Currency) total FROM a)
SELECT Currency currency,COUNT(*) product_count,ROUND(SUM(POWER(CAST(v AS DECIMAL(60,18))/total,2)),6) hhi FROM b GROUP BY Currency ORDER BY Currency

, a AS (SELECT c.Currency,t.CustomerID,SUM(t.p) v FROM t JOIN birdbench.customers c ON t.CustomerID=c.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency IS NOT NULL AND t.p IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.Currency,t.CustomerID HAVING SUM(t.p)>0),r AS (SELECT a.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY Currency ORDER BY v DESC,CustomerID) rn,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY Currency) n FROM a)
SELECT Currency currency,COUNT(*) customer_count,SUM(CASE WHEN rn<=CEIL(n*0.1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) selected_customers,ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rn<=CEIL(n*0.1) THEN CAST(v AS DECIMAL(60,18)) ELSE 0 END)/SUM(v),6) top_share FROM r GROUP BY Currency ORDER BY Currency

WITH t AS (
SELECT tr.*, CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS p,
CASE WHEN Date IS NOT NULL AND Time REGEXP '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$'
THEN TIMESTAMP(Date,Time) ELSE NULL END AS ts FROM birdbench.transactions_1k tr),

, a AS (SELECT GasStationID,ProductID,COUNT(*) n FROM t WHERE GasStationID IS NOT NULL AND ProductID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY GasStationID,ProductID),b AS (SELECT a.*,SUM(n) OVER(PARTITION BY GasStationID) total FROM a)
SELECT GasStationID station_id,MAX(total) transaction_count,COUNT(*) product_count,ROUND(-SUM((CAST(n AS DECIMAL(60,18))/total)*LN(CAST(n AS DECIMAL(60,18))/total)),6) entropy_nats FROM b GROUP BY GasStationID ORDER BY GasStationID

WITH t AS (
SELECT tr.*, CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS p,
CASE WHEN Date IS NOT NULL AND Time REGEXP '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$'
THEN TIMESTAMP(Date,Time) ELSE NULL END AS ts FROM birdbench.transactions_1k tr),
m AS (SELECT CustomerID, Date AS ym, STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(Date,'01'),'%%Y%%m%%d') AS md,
CAST(Consumption AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS v FROM birdbench.yearmonth
WHERE Date REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' AND LEFT(Date,4) BETWEEN '1000' AND '9999')
, a AS (SELECT c.Currency,g.Country,t.ProductID,SUM(t.Amount) qty,AVG(CAST(t.p AS DECIMAL(60,18))/t.Amount) mean_u FROM t JOIN birdbench.customers c ON t.CustomerID=c.CustomerID JOIN birdbench.gasstations g ON t.GasStationID=g.GasStationID WHERE c.Currency IS NOT NULL AND g.Country IN ('CZE','SVK') AND t.ProductID IS NOT NULL AND t.Amount>0 AND t.p IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.Currency,g.Country,t.ProductID),b AS (SELECT a.Currency,a.ProductID,a.qty+b.qty w,a.mean_u cze,b.mean_u svk FROM a JOIN a b ON a.Currency=b.Currency AND a.ProductID=b.ProductID AND a.Country='CZE' AND b.Country='SVK')
SELECT Currency currency,COUNT(*) common_products,ROUND(SUM(w*cze)/SUM(w),6) cze_index,ROUND(SUM(w*svk)/SUM(w),6) svk_index,ROUND(SUM(w*(cze-svk))/SUM(w),6) difference FROM b GROUP BY Currency ORDER BY Currency

SELECT tr.*, CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS p,
CASE WHEN Date IS NOT NULL AND Time REGEXP '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$'
THEN TIMESTAMP(Date,Time) ELSE NULL END AS ts FROM birdbench.transactions_1k tr),
m AS (SELECT CustomerID, Date AS ym, STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(Date,'01'),'%%Y%%m%%d') AS md,
CAST(Consumption AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS v FROM birdbench.yearmonth
WHERE Date REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' AND LEFT(Date,4) BETWEEN '1000' AND '9999')
, a AS (SELECT g.Country,c.Currency,COUNT(*) n FROM t JOIN birdbench.customers c ON t.CustomerID=c.CustomerID JOIN birdbench.gasstations g ON t.GasStationID=g.GasStationID WHERE g.Country IS NOT NULL AND c.Currency IS NOT NULL GROUP BY g.Country,c.Currency),co AS (SELECT Country,SUM(n) n FROM a GROUP BY Country),cu AS (SELECT Currency,SUM(n) n FROM a GROUP BY Currency),tot AS (SELECT SUM(n) n FROM a),b AS (SELECT co.Country,cu.Currency,COALESCE(a.n,0) observed,CAST(co.n AS DECIMAL(60,18))*cu.n/tot.n expected FROM co CROSS JOIN cu CROSS JOIN tot LEFT JOIN a ON co.Country=a.Country AND cu.Currency=a.Currency)
SELECT Country country,Currency currency,observed observed_count,ROUND(expected,6) expected_count,ROUND(POWER(observed-expected,2)/expected,6) pearson_component FROM b ORDER BY Country,Currency

, a AS (SELECT c.Currency,c.Segment,COUNT(*) n,SUM(t.p) total,AVG(t.p) mean_p FROM t JOIN birdbench.customers c ON t.CustomerID=c.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency IS NOT NULL AND c.Segment IS NOT NULL AND t.p IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.Currency,c.Segment),u AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Currency) n FROM a),common AS (SELECT Segment FROM a GROUP BY Segment HAVING COUNT(*)=(SELECT n FROM u))
SELECT a.Currency currency,COUNT(*) common_segments,ROUND(AVG(a.mean_p),6) standardized_mean,ROUND(CAST(SUM(a.total) AS DECIMAL(60,18))/SUM(a.n),6) raw_matched_mean FROM a JOIN common b ON a.Segment=b.Segment GROUP BY a.Currency ORDER BY a.Currency

WITH t AS (
SELECT tr.*, CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS p,

CAST(Consumption AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS v FROM birdbench.yearmonth
WHERE Date REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' AND LEFT(Date,4) BETWEEN '1000' AND '9999')
, a AS (SELECT ProductID,Amount,CAST(p AS DECIMAL(60,18))/Amount u FROM t WHERE ProductID IS NOT NULL AND p IS NOT NULL AND Amount>0)
SELECT ProductID product_id,COUNT(*) observation_count,ROUND(AVG(CAST(Amount AS DECIMAL(38,12))),6) mean_amount,ROUND(AVG(u),6) mean_unit_price,ROUND(AVG(Amount*u)-AVG(CAST(Amount AS DECIMAL(38,12)))*AVG(u),6) covariance FROM a GROUP BY ProductID ORDER BY ProductID

WITH t AS (
SELECT tr.*, CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS p,
CASE WHEN Date IS NOT NULL AND Time REGEXP '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$'
THEN TIMESTAMP(Date,Time) ELSE NULL END AS ts FROM birdbench.transactions_1k tr),

WHERE Date REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' AND LEFT(Date,4) BETWEEN '1000' AND '9999')
, a AS (SELECT CustomerID,DATE_FORMAT(Date,'%%Y%%m') ym,COUNT(*) n FROM t WHERE CustomerID IS NOT NULL AND Date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CustomerID,DATE_FORMAT(Date,'%%Y%%m')),b AS (SELECT CustomerID,ym FROM m),k AS (SELECT CustomerID,ym FROM a UNION SELECT CustomerID,ym FROM b),d AS (SELECT 'both' coverage UNION ALL SELECT 'monthly_only' UNION ALL SELECT 'transaction_only'),x AS (SELECT CASE WHEN a.CustomerID IS NOT NULL AND b.CustomerID IS NOT NULL THEN 'both' WHEN a.CustomerID IS NOT NULL THEN 'transaction_only' ELSE 'monthly_only' END coverage,COALESCE(a.n,0) n FROM k LEFT JOIN a ON k.CustomerID=a.CustomerID AND k.ym=a.ym LEFT JOIN b ON k.CustomerID=b.CustomerID AND k.ym=b.ym)
SELECT d.coverage,COUNT(x.coverage) key_count,COALESCE(SUM(x.n),0) transaction_count FROM d LEFT JOIN x ON d.coverage=x.coverage GROUP BY d.coverage ORDER BY d.coverage

WITH t AS (
SELECT tr.*, CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS p,
CASE WHEN Date IS NOT NULL AND Time REGEXP '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$'
THEN TIMESTAMP(Date,Time) ELSE NULL END AS ts FROM birdbench.transactions_1k tr),
m AS (SELECT CustomerID, Date AS ym, STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(Date,'01'),'%%Y%%m%%d') AS md,
CAST(Consumption AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS v FROM birdbench.yearmonth
WHERE Date REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' AND LEFT(Date,4) BETWEEN '1000' AND '9999')
SELECT CASE WHEN t.CustomerID IS NULL THEN 'NULL_KEY' WHEN c.CustomerID IS NULL THEN 'ORPHAN' ELSE 'MATCHED' END customer_status,CASE WHEN t.GasStationID IS NULL THEN 'NULL_KEY' WHEN g.GasStationID IS NULL THEN 'ORPHAN' ELSE 'MATCHED' END station_status,CASE WHEN t.ProductID IS NULL THEN 'NULL_KEY' WHEN p.ProductID IS NULL THEN 'ORPHAN' ELSE 'MATCHED' END product_status,COUNT(*) transaction_count FROM t LEFT JOIN birdbench.customers c ON t.CustomerID=c.CustomerID LEFT JOIN birdbench.gasstations g ON t.GasStationID=g.GasStationID LEFT JOIN birdbench.products p ON t.ProductID=p.ProductID GROUP BY customer_status,station_status,product_status ORDER BY customer_status,station_status,product_status

WITH t AS (
SELECT tr.*, CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS p,
CASE WHEN Date IS NOT NULL AND Time REGEXP '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$'
THEN TIMESTAMP(Date,Time) ELSE NULL END AS ts FROM birdbench.transactions_1k tr),
m AS (SELECT CustomerID, Date AS ym, STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(Date,'01'),'%%Y%%m%%d') AS md,
CAST(Consumption AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS v FROM birdbench.yearmonth

, a AS (SELECT ProductID,COUNT(*) n FROM t GROUP BY ProductID),b AS (SELECT p.Description,COUNT(*) n,SUM(COALESCE(a.n,0)) tx FROM birdbench.products p LEFT JOIN a ON p.ProductID=a.ProductID WHERE p.Description IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.Description)

WITH t AS (
SELECT tr.*, CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS p,
CASE WHEN Date IS NOT NULL AND Time REGEXP '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$'
THEN TIMESTAMP(Date,Time) ELSE NULL END AS ts FROM birdbench.transactions_1k tr),
m AS (SELECT CustomerID, Date AS ym, STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(Date,'01'),'%%Y%%m%%d') AS md,
CAST(Consumption AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS v FROM birdbench.yearmonth
WHERE Date REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' AND LEFT(Date,4) BETWEEN '1000' AND '9999')
, a AS (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID FROM birdbench.yearmonth),b AS (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID FROM t)
SELECT c.Segment segment,c.Currency currency,CASE WHEN a.CustomerID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END monthly_present,CASE WHEN b.CustomerID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END transaction_present,COUNT(*) customer_count FROM birdbench.customers c LEFT JOIN a ON c.CustomerID=a.CustomerID LEFT JOIN b ON c.CustomerID=b.CustomerID GROUP BY c.Segment,c.Currency,monthly_present,transaction_present ORDER BY c.Segment,c.Currency,monthly_present,transaction_present

WITH t AS (
SELECT tr.*, CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS p,
CASE WHEN Date IS NOT NULL AND Time REGEXP '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$'
THEN TIMESTAMP(Date,Time) ELSE NULL END AS ts FROM birdbench.transactions_1k tr),
m AS (SELECT CustomerID, Date AS ym, STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(Date,'01'),'%%Y%%m%%d') AS md,
CAST(Consumption AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS v FROM birdbench.yearmonth
WHERE Date REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' AND LEFT(Date,4) BETWEEN '1000' AND '9999'), a AS (SELECT c.Currency,t.ProductID,t.CustomerID,COUNT(*) n,SUM(t.p) total FROM t JOIN birdbench.customers c ON t.CustomerID=c.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency IS NOT NULL AND t.ProductID IS NOT NULL AND t.p IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.Currency,t.ProductID,t.CustomerID),
b AS (SELECT a.*,SUM(n) OVER(PARTITION BY Currency,ProductID) all_n,SUM(total) OVER(PARTITION BY Currency,ProductID) all_total FROM a),
g AS (SELECT Currency,CAST(total AS DECIMAL(60,18))/n-CAST(all_total-total AS DECIMAL(60,18))/(all_n-n) gap FROM b WHERE all_n>n)
SELECT Currency currency,COUNT(*) eligible_customer_product_pairs,SUM(CASE WHEN gap>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) above_peer_pairs,ROUND(AVG(gap),6) mean_price_gap FROM g GROUP BY Currency ORDER BY Currency

WITH t AS (
SELECT tr.*, CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS p,
CASE WHEN Date IS NOT NULL AND Time REGEXP '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$'
THEN TIMESTAMP(Date,Time) ELSE NULL END AS ts FROM birdbench.transactions_1k tr),
m AS (SELECT CustomerID, Date AS ym, STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(Date,'01'),'%%Y%%m%%d') AS md,
CAST(Consumption AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS v FROM birdbench.yearmonth
WHERE Date REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' AND LEFT(Date,4) BETWEEN '1000' AND '9999')
, a AS (SELECT c.Currency,t.CustomerID,MAX(CASE WHEN t.ProductID=2 AND t.Date<'2012-08-25' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) bp,MAX(CASE WHEN t.ProductID=2 AND t.Date>='2012-08-25' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ap FROM t JOIN birdbench.customers c ON t.CustomerID=c.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency IS NOT NULL AND t.Date>='2012-08-23' AND t.Date<'2012-08-27' GROUP BY c.Currency,t.CustomerID)
SELECT Currency currency,bp before_present,ap after_present,COUNT(*) customer_count FROM a GROUP BY Currency,bp,ap ORDER BY Currency,bp,ap
